parse.title: A Note For Yourself
parse.wikitext:
{{Event Header|Event-SelfNote.png}} {{E|A Note For Yourself}} is an [[Event]] encountered in all [[Acts]]. ==Options== {{Frame|Take and Give}} {{TS|positive||Receive and Store a Card}} * Receive a card that you had stored previously, and store a card in your deck in return. ** The first time the player encounters this event in their save file, it will have {{C|Iron Wave}} stored. {{Frame|Ignore}} Nothing happens.

You are then given the option to {{Frame|Leave}}. ==Dialogue==
You spot a loose brick within a pillar that catches your eye.
You find a folded note and a {{TS|gold||card}} inside. It reads,
"The Heart awaits"

This is your handwriting.

{{Frame|Take and Give}}
Choose a Card to Store.
Prior to {{Frame|Leave}}
"What is going on?"
==Gameplay Notes== * This event can store a card between runs, and allows the player to obtain a card from a different character. * On {{Asc|14}} or lower, the player must have beaten that Ascension level on the chosen character in order to encounter this event. * On {{Asc|15}} or higher, this event cannot be encountered. * Playing the [[Custom Mode|Daily Climb]] also disables this event. * If you store an upgraded card, it remains upgraded when found on another run. ** {{C|Searing Blow}} retains its upgrade level when it was stored. * Retrieving a card is considered adding a card to your deck, and will trigger relics such as {{R|Molten Egg}}, {{R|Toxic Egg}}, {{R|Frozen Egg}}, and {{R|Ceramic Fish}}. {{EventNav}} [[Category:Events]]
